name: com.texasdeedrestrictions/texas-deed-restrictions
title: Texas Deed Restrictions
description: Look up Texas deed restrictions by address, with verbatim recorded quotes. Travis County beta.

tools.name: lookup_restrictions
tools.description:
Look up recorded deed restrictions for a Texas parcel.

    `address`: a street address (e.g. "6310 Needham Ln, Austin TX 78739"; case, suffix
    spelling, city/state/ZIP are tolerated) or a parcel id (Travis: TCAD prop_id / geo_id; Hays: HAYS-<prop_id>).
    Returns parcel info, applicable documents (oldest first, with amendment chain),
    verbatim clauses grouped by topic, coverage of sources searched, and a disclaimer.
    If no parcel matches, returns covered=false with suggestions; it never guesses.

address.description: Street address of a Travis County, Texas property (e.g. "6310 Needham Ln, Austin TX 78739"; case, suffix spelling, city/state/ZIP optional), or a parcel id: TCAD prop_id (e.g. "340632") or geo_id.
address.title: Address

tools.name: get_clauses
tools.description:
Get restriction clauses applying to a parcel (prop_id or geo_id as returned by lookup_restrictions), optionally
    filtered by topic: units_per_lot, single_family, setbacks, use, short_term_rental, fences,
    accessory_buildings, min_size, duration_renewal, amendment_process, other.
    Superseded clauses are flagged and listed last.

prop_id.description: Parcel id as returned by lookup_restrictions (TCAD prop_id or geo_id).
prop_id.title: Prop Id

topic.description: Optional topic filter: units_per_lot, single_family, setbacks, use, short_term_rental, fences, accessory_buildings, min_size, duration_renewal, amendment_process or other. Omit for all topics.
topic.title: Topic

tools.name: get_document
tools.description:
Get a recorded document's metadata (instrument no., volume/page, recorded date,
    enforcer, source URL, amendment chain), its scope rows, and its extracted clauses.

doc_id.description: Document id from the documents list of lookup_restrictions or get_clauses (e.g. "TRV-DEC-10585-110").
doc_id.title: Doc Id

tools.name: coverage
tools.description:
Which record sources have been searched (and with what result) for a parcel's
    subdivision or for a subdivision name, e.g. "Circle C Ranch Phs B Sec 2".

address_or_subdivision.description: A street address or parcel id, or a subdivision name as recorded by TCAD (e.g. "Circle C Ranch Phs B Sec 2").
address_or_subdivision.title: Address Or Subdivision
